hypothesis: A single learned metric-only ranker can use resource and independent HTTP observations better than a fixed RED maximum when traces are absent.
scope: Latency and HTTP-error incidents only; not CPU, memory or arbitrary fault coverage. Research only, no runtime promotion in this screen.
representation: metric-semantics-v1, 28 columns, identical raw transform for training and retained Petclinic captures; healthy is separate

controls: max positive median error/latency shift from the same new transform
evaluation.disclosure: Different modalities: the challenger and RED control use independent HTTP data, frozen core uses original resources without traces. Extra-data gain is not an algorithm-only claim. No confidence percentage or time-saving claim. No new universal accuracy.
evaluation.label_join: Fit labels joined only after all training matrices are saved; transfer labels joined only after all transfer predictions are saved. Predictor takes numeric features only.

safety.failed_oracle_or_source_gate: NO_FIT, preserve partial capture, do not silently retry

next: If the gate fails, stop this learned-HTTP branch and keep the champion. If it passes, register a small fresh C3 before collecting or promoting anything; no automatic product integration.
